changeVerdicts.1 5 mm dark joint under every taupe cap,: adjust. In z_wardrobe it reads as a black blade (L8-17 over ~9 px at DPR 2) rather than a shadowed joint, and at the aft end of the wardrobe wall the square 2 mm-proud box sticks out past the shell's rounded corner into air (z_wardrobe x 195-245, y 238-252, L13 against background L57-70; also c_ward.png lower half, left end). omaat_f40 shows the cap-to-shell joint as a soft shadow about the shell's shaded value (L110-115), not a black line. Fix: make it recessed (cw - 0.004, cd - 0.004, so it never overhangs the rounded shell), 3 mm tall, and a mid-dark colour (~#3a342e) so it reads as a shadow groove.
changeVerdicts.2 dark welt between ottoman cushion and: keep. Reads as a real welt / shadow under the cushion edge (z_ottoman y 795-805, L7-9); f11 has a dark line there (L24-31). Could be lifted slightly (#2a2520) but not required.
changeVerdicts.3 aisle box lid seam: keep. Thin dark line under the lid (c_q05_ott, z_ottoman); f11 lid line L4. No z-fighting seen.
changeVerdicts.4 dark underside line behind the table's: keep. Thickens the dark lip slightly (z_ottoman y 440-490), consistent with f11.
changeVerdicts.5 fascia / body joint on the window cons: keep (neutral). Barely visible at 1x or DPR 2 (z_console); no artefact.
changeVerdicts.6 wardrobe door reveal + wood panel spli: keep. The 5 mm reveal reads as a real door gap inside the taupe frame, as around the door leaf in omaat_f5 / f13; no z-fighting at DPR 2 (z_wardrobe). The split lines at the wood panel edges are uniformly black but read as reveals, acceptable.
changeVerdicts.7 (monuments) softer ink-cloud print: not scored. Note: in q03/q05 the front wall now reads as a beige-grey smoky mottle; f13 / f40 show pale blue-grey with distinct white cloud bands. Passed to the monuments raters.
